newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tuskar says Obe-4 well flows oil at 9,500bpd.
newsitem.headline: Tuskar says Obe-4 well flows oil at 9,500bpd.

text.p: Tuskar Resources Plc said on Wednesday that the Obe-4 well located offshore Nigeria flowed oil at 9,500 barrels per day.
The well was drilled to a total measured depth of 9,315 feet and encountered 135 feet of oil pay.
It successfully flow tested high quality oil from two reservoirs at a combined rate of 9,500 barrels per day, Tuskar said in a statement.
"The oil flow far exceeded the company's expectations and the Obe-4 well will be completed as a dual zone oil producing well," it added.

Tuskar managing director Emmet Brown said it was a highly significant achievement for the company, both technically and commercially, and underpinned plans to generate early cashflow in Nigeria through fast-track development of the Obe Oil Field.

"Knowing the Obe-4 well's excellent oil production capability, we can now proceed with added confidence to negotiate contracts for offshore production facilities required to bring the oil onstream, while concurrently advancing plans to drill and complete Obe-5, the second development well in the Obe Oil Field before year-end," Brown said.

Tuskar is the technical operator of the Obe Oil Field and holds a 40 percent working interest in the OML 110 concession under an agreement which entitles it to 75 percent profits on the first 50 million barrels of oil produced.
